# Compiler runtime files follow the host tools into the temporary GOROOT,
# including when compile is replaced by the compiler test executable.
exists $GOROOT/pkg/tool/${GOOS}_${GOARCH}/lib
! exists $GOROOT/pkg/goallc-llvmplugin
! exists $GOROOT/pkg/goallc-llvm-payload
env GOALLC_LLVM_DIR=
go tool compile -enablellvm -V=full
stdout 'buildID=goallc-'
go tool compile -enablellvm -llvm-keep-ir -p=p -o p.a p.go
exists p.a p.a.ll

-- p.go --
package p
func F(x int) int { return x + 1 }
